Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This SAFETY-tier review found no blocking item.
I tested the trial merge locally with upstream/main `c4ac3ce6da5d79e572b82ec94bc965427cd63eeb`.
I checked the laws in that upstream revision.

- Circular reuses the existing certified KeepDown link for eligible Ramp transitions.
- The material height keeps the initial rapid above stock over Top Z.
- The tests retain smaller entry gaps, alternative transitions, Retract links, ring changes and the final retract.
- The new app fixture verifies four cases and reports zero gouge cells.
- No UI, importer, dependency, build script or process file changes require a separate check.

**Local build and test results**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 630 steps passed; zero failed. The logs contain 5,023 passed tests.
- The explicit extra suites passed 651 tests. See the named suites below.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 218 steps passed; zero failed. I ran all reached lanes locally.

**Independent mutations**

1. Remove the 0.1 mm cap. `circular_first_ramp_starts_just_above_material` fails at line 166. The first ramp starts 2 mm above material.
2. Remove the KeepDown selection. `circular_ramp_stays_down_between_levels_of_one_ring` fails at line 137. It finds 12 lifts instead of one.

After each restoration, all six `circular_ramp_angle` tests pass.
After the old-code comparison and restoration, both `circular_stay_down` tests pass.
All temporary changes stayed in the review worktree. No evidence was committed to the PR branch.

**Golden check**

I generated the same fixture with the old generator and compared every changed line.
The old path has 185 moves. The new path has 133 moves.
The initial ramps start at Z6.1 instead of Z8.0 over stock at Z6.0.
The change removes the intermediate clearance rapid pairs.
The cut rings, interlevel descent arcs, ring changes and final retract match.
No existing golden or `.nc` file changes.

I searched the fixture readers and ran these suites explicitly after the quick gate.
The diff does not trigger the additional importer suites.
